spec.description: Count the events a query matches, without fetching them.

request.title: EventCountRequest
request.description: The same filters `query` takes, minus the ones that only shape the output.

format.description: Response format. Only `geojson` is representable here; the service also serves plain text and XML.

starttime.description: Earliest origin time to include, UTC. Inclusive.

endtime.description: Latest origin time to include, UTC. Inclusive.

latitude.description: Latitude of the centre of a circular search area, in decimal degrees. Requires `maxradiuskm`.

longitude.description: Longitude of the centre of a circular search area, in decimal degrees. Requires `maxradiuskm`.

maxradiuskm.description: Radius of the circular search area around `latitude`/`longitude`, in kilometres.

mindepth.description: Shallowest depth to include, in kilometres.

maxdepth.description: Deepest depth to include, in kilometres.

response.title: EventCount
response.description: How many events matched, and how many the service would have served.

count.description: Number of events matching the query.

maxAllowed.description: Most events `query` will return for one request; a `count` above it is a query that has to be narrowed or walked.

notes: `maxAllowed` is why this endpoint is worth calling before `query`: a query matching more than it is a query the service will refuse, and this is the cheap way to find that out.
